Processing & Shipping:
Orders are usually processed within 1-5 business days before being shipped

Tracking Updates:
Once the shipping label is created, it can take up to 72 hours for the courier to scan the package and begin displaying live tracking updates
So in total, you should receive your tracking number within 1-5 business days after placing your order, and then the tracking link may take an additional 72 hours to show active updates.
